parameters.description: Slug of the workspace the project belongs to
parameters.name: workspace_slug

parameters.description:
Keeps only test runs from builds that ran on one of these git branches. Repeat the parameter
for several values: branch=main&branch=develop. '*' matches any run of characters, so
branch=release/* keeps every release branch. Omit to include every branch.
parameters.name: branch

parameters.description: End of the reported time window, exclusive, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Must be after 'start'.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Keeps only test runs from builds of one of these pipelines. Repeatable, like 'branch'.
parameters.name: pipeline

parameters.description: ID of the project to report on. Exactly one is required.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Start of the reported time window, inclusive, as an RFC3339 timestamp.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Keeps only runs of one of these test suites. Repeatable, like 'branch'.
parameters.name: test_suite

parameters.description: Keeps only test runs from builds of one of these workflows. Repeatable, like 'branch'.
parameters.name: workflow
